notes: The %augGEE1 macro (single-step augmented GEE approach of Geroldinger, Blagus, Ogden, Heinze 2022) is reproduced verbatim. The repo ships no example caller, so a small caller with mock clustered rare-event data (20 obs, one cluster per row via id=) was added: %augGEE1(data=rare_event, y=y, varlist=x1 x2, id=id). Runs unmodified end to end: fits the Firth model, builds the pseudo-observation clusters, sorts and re-clusters them, and fits the augmented PROC GEE model with a compound-symmetry working correlation.
